items.body:
Should there be like a json file for all the incoming mail items that haven’t been added to the mailbag nkai mail session. And should the mailbag session be a persistent thing? It feels like it ought to be. Also, can we codify a way for me to set priorities for mail items? I had one say it’s the highest priority. But, like, I want THIS to be highest priority and this has a newer time stamp. I want this to be the first item in the mail bag nkai session and any previous top priorities like that in line after this, in like reverse chronological order for the timestamps!! And, if the rejigger thinks those should be later, add that to the response to place it in the suggested order and move to the next TOP PRIORITY and give me the same suggestion (if now is ok or if it should be moved with a button to correctly slot it in order the rejigger suggested). Which means we should probably grab the original timestamps from the files (probably both created and modified times)

Also, if we make a persistent mail bag nkai session that has like all the history, can we keep calling it the mail bag and call the inbox the mail box, just for my own sanity? And probably add that to the glossary 

Also top priority, probably make a rollback system for the rejigger. And a rollback for fetching and archiving the mail and adding the new mail to the mailbag. In case I run out of allowance … I do have overage credits, but some time soon I may not, so better safe than sorry. Also, I have like 6% left for the week. And, like, if I don’t use it all, that’s just money I left on table.

items.title: Spun-Up Flash Low Agent for N'kai-to-Chat Button Routing (P1) — 🪦 GRAVEYARD / KILLED
items.preview: - Topic ID: Topic 16 - Source Note: [Nkai Button Flash Routing Agent.md](file:///C:/Dev/TheKlangVault/Inbox/Archive/Nkai%20Button%20Flash%20Routing%20Agent.md) - Capture Date: 2026-10-11 | Triage Date: 2026-10-11 | Status: 🪦 GRAVEYARD / KILLED | Tier: Tier 3 Minimal
items.body:
- **Topic ID:** `Topic 16`
- **Source Note:** [`Nkai Button Flash Routing Agent.md`](file:///C:/Dev/TheKlangVault/Inbox/Archive/Nkai%20Button%20Flash%20Routing%20Agent.md)
- **Capture Date:** 2026-10-11 | **Triage Date:** 2026-10-11 | **Status:** `🪦 GRAVEYARD / KILLED` | **Tier:** Tier 3 Minimal
- **Original Prompt:** *"maybe the button interaction needs a spun up flash low agent to do all the routing between nkai and the chat? a topic to look into when my weekly allowance is back. add it to the top of the untriaged in the mailbag! I'm at 1%, so just add it, don't look into it right now hahaha"*
- **Key Angles & Online Research Dossier:**
  - **The Plumbing vs. Reasoning Trap**: LLMs are probabilistic neural networks with 500ms–2s latency and token burn per turn. Using an LLM subagent as a static string relay for DOM button clicks is classic architectural over-engineering ("using an LLM for plumbing").
  - **Subagent Lifecycle Limits**: In Antigravity, subagents can only be spawned during an active LLM turn, not by an external webview click. A subagent cannot run an indefinite polling loop without hitting turn/timer limits.
  - **The Built-In Solution**: When running as an official Antigravity UI Extension (`plugins/nkai/sidecars/panel/`), the panel has direct access to `window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage(text)` via `/preload.js` — providing 100% deterministic, 0ms latency, zero-token dispatch directly into the chat conversation.
- **PCDA Dialectic Synthesis**:
  - **Pros**: Pure hands-free operation; eliminates `Ctrl+V`.
  - **Cons**: 1–2s inference latency per click; base prompt token burn; hallucination risk during parameter passing.
  - **Devil's Advocate**: Burning tokens on two models (subagent + main agent) just to forward a button click is the definition of AI slop.
  - **80/20 Resolution**: **REJECT the Flash Routing Subagent (`🪦 GRAVEYARD`)**. Rely on Antigravity's native `window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage()` when running as an official UI extension, and maintain the honest 1-click `[ 📋 Copy ]` composer for standalone browser views.

---
